Hospitals and emergency rooms have seen pain, loss, and desperation due to COVID-19 and its variant surges. 

Uplifting the mental health and wellness of those in the health workforce will support them, their families & the communities they serve.

🇺🇸 Today is #ElectionDay! 🚨

Free and fair elections are the foundation of our democracy. Don't forget to exercise your right to vote! Every election cycle, thousands of volunteers across the country help make your voice heard.

Patients and families look to our nurses for more than medical care. Our nurses also provide support and compassion during our times of need. On #NationalNursesWeek, we honor the nurses who have left a mark on countless lives. https://t.co/ddyqg7HMeS

We must make sure doctors have the tools they need to save patients with resistant infections, and the PASTEUR Act would do just that. 

Click below to read what our bill would do to relieve the complex public health problem.

https://t.co/1sHwCyfYqE

Delivering these results is why I fought to include my Reduced Costs and Continued Cures Act in the IRA.

The list includes lifesaving medicines for diabetes, cancer, and heart disease which cost Medicare patients $3.4B in out-of-pocket costs in 2022 alone.

I will continue working with the Biden administration to ensure that drug price negotiation serves patients by reducing their out-of-pocket costs while facilitating the discovery of new cures and treatments in the US.
A member of my staff reached out to SSA, Esther got the medical coverage she was entitled to, and the bill was rescinded.

2022's Inflation Reduction Act included my drug-pricing reform framework, which capped seniors' out-of-pocket insulin costs. We knew then that it would pressure drug manufacturers to make insulin more affordable. This is good news for diabetes all patients https://t.co/6zKmD7MlgX https://t.co/bmsZGCQoDH

Earlier this week, I welcomed @SenLaphonza Butler to San Diego to discuss local priorities, including securing $310 million to rehab and expand the South Bay wastewater treatment plant through the Senate. I appreciated the chance to connect as well as her knowledge of our region. https://t.co/JXy2R8ymk2

Securing the $310m needed to repair and expand the South Bay wastewater treatment plant is an all-hands-on-deck effort. I appreciate @RichardPBailey and Councilmember John Duncan traveling to Washington, D.C., to push for this much-needed funding: https://t.co/eCdRSgnPjJ

I enjoyed touring @LundbeckUS La Jolla Research Center this week and hearing about innovative treatments in the pipeline, including one to alleviate debilitating neuropathy suffered so many cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy. #CA50 is home to many medical innovators!  ￼ https://t.co/sRntRnxvWx
Good news for Californians who need health insurance: Covered California is extending its enrollment deadline to midnight Feb. 9 to sign up for coverage in 2024. Details: https://t.co/DAhdx91KJ7

Casework success! Elizabeth from Pacific Beach contacted my office after her husband Robert’s Social Security benefits were inexplicably terminated. The loss of benefits — and of Robert’s Medicare coverage — caused the couple significant financial and emotional distress. +

A member of my staff reached out to the Social Security Administration, which eventually determined that Robert’s benefits were erroneously terminated and issued him a check immediately for $7,200 in to cover missed payments. Robert's Medicare coverage was also reinstated.

In January, when I participated in the @RTFHSD homeless count, I saw people in desperate need of a safe place to sleep and the help of case managers who could connect them to services. I'm certain this new shelter will transform many lives.

Wishing Director Collins a successful surgery and full recovery.
His message of early detection and prompt treatment is essential to saving lives. Talk to your healthcare provider and learn more here: https://t.co/RBvWRz0sAC
https://t.co/sZfcctH9Zr

Health care decisions should be made between patients and providers, NOT judges and politicians. Especially when those decisions are life or death. 

I will keep fighting alongside my @ProChoiceCaucus colleagues to protect access to emergency abortion care.
Too many San Diegans lack a safe place to sleep. While the region has increased focus and resources on tackling homelessness, we must do more to lower the cost of housing. https://t.co/kDmkcjxuMI

Women should never face barriers when it comes to reproductive health care. Even in California, which has has taken steps to safeguard abortion rights, there might be confusion over insurance coverage or questions about what to do if a medical provider isn't following the law. My website now includes a comprehensive list of local, state, and federal resources about reproductive rights and how to access care. https://t.co/c7ALkiwEQ7

Definitely a bummer, though not surprising. The good news is we're finally making needed repairs to the South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant and due to break ground on the expansion by year's end. I'm leaving no stone unturned looking for funding to finish the job and working to hold Mexico accountable to do its part. https://t.co/LKM3LAK9AR
Great news indeed from @usibwc about important next steps in the repair and upgrade of the South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant. My statement: https://t.co/6plSWWpEmG

This week, my colleagues and I called on the State Department to get answers from Mexico about the recent increase in trash and sediment in the Tijuana River. While we’re making progress on fixing wastewater treatment on our side of the border, we need Mexico to work with us to stop the flows at the heart of the problem. The people of San Diego deserve nothing less. https://t.co/Xpu96QeW0m

The broken South Bay wastewater treatment plant is the federal government’s responsibility. That's why it's important for federal officials to understand the scope of the problem. I appreciate U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Richard R. Verma traveling to San Diego to see (and smell) the cross-border sewage problem firsthand. https://t.co/Za4wwPJJ8O

We must do everything possible to prevent future pandemics.

My PASTEUR Act w/ @SenatorBennet & @SenToddYoung will help us develop better antibiotics and ensure they're used responsibly to stop the emergence of new superbugs.
